physics_goals.quote: The China Dark Matter Experiment (CDEX) experiment is going to directly detect the WIMP flux with high sensitivity in the low mass region.
physics_goals.value: Direct detection of light WIMPs with sub-keV germanium detectors

summary.plain: CDEX-1 was the first stage of the CDEX programme: a single 1 kg germanium crystal in the Jinping underground laboratory in China, tuned to notice the tiny energy of very light dark matter particles. It saw no dark matter, and its results disfavoured earlier claimed signals.
summary.technical: p-type point-contact germanium (pPCGe) detector, 994 g crystal (CDEX-1A) then CDEX-1B, at CJPL (>2400 m rock). First limit from 14.6 kg d with a 400 eVee threshold; later 737.1 kg d at 160 eVee; a 3.2 yr annual-modulation analysis excludes the DAMA/LIBRA and CoGeNT modulation regions at >99.99% and 98% C.L. in the standard halo model.
